title: Along bank
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：along　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 along 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the tailor kept the needle ① along the whole morning at the mirror, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the needle had been left ② along the river bank, and nobody had asked a single question. The tailor had come to the shop two weeks earlier and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The order for November 1947 puts it plainer. It was done ③ along the old track, and the customer who kept the needle had mended it ④ along the line of willows twice before the winter came; nothing in the shop was ever done along the old track in those days. The customer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ along the water, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ along the edge of the field; he was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1960 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was that the needle be mended ⑦ along the fence, and that the names be written ⑧ along the margin of the map. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried along the fence.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1963 she kept the needle  along the whole morning again when nobody else would, and  along the river bank, she said in 1965, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the needle in the same mirror for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot what had been done along the river bank.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 沿着（表时间：along the whole morning）
B. prep. 沿着（表处所：along the river bank）
C. prep. 顺着（表方式／状态：along the old track）
D. prep. 顺着（引出施动者或相关的人：be mended along the line of willows）
E. prep. 沿着（表原因：along the water）
F. prep. 顺着（表对象／目的：along the edge of the field）
G. prep. 沿着（表工具／材料：along the fence）
H. prep. 顺着（表载体／处所：written along the margin of the map）

items.q: along the edge of the field
along the margin of the map

answers.why: along 意为“沿着”，此处引出时间 the whole morning（整个上午），说明那件细细的针是在何时留下的。
along 意为“沿着”，此处引出处所 the river bank（河岸），说明东西被放在何处。
along 意为“顺着”，此处引出方式或状态 the old track（那条旧道），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
along 意为“顺着”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 沿岸的柳树：be mended along the line of willows。
along 意为“沿着”，此处引出原因 the water（水势），说明整件事由何而起。
along 意为“顺着”，此处引出对象或目的 the edge of the field（田边）。
along 意为“沿着”，此处引出工具或材料 the fence（那道篱笆）。
along 意为“顺着”，此处引出载体 the margin of the map（地图的页边）：names written along the margin of the map。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年整个上午前后，裁缝把那件细细的针留在了试衣镜。（along the whole morning）
那件细细的针被放在河岸，谁也没有过问。（along the river bank）
整件事是那条旧道做成的，订单簿上写得明白。（along the old track）
入冬之前，那件细细的针已经由沿岸的柳树补过两回。（be mended along the line of willows）
叔叔说，整件事是由水势起的。（along the water）
他说，家里从来没有人为田边做过这件事。（along the edge of the field）
answers: In 1953 the tailor kept the needle along the whole morning at the mirror.
The needle had been left along the river bank, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done along the old track, or so the order says.
The needle had been mended along the line of willows twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun along the water.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it along the edge of the field.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 along 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the tailor kept the needle along the whole morning, and nobody forgot it.
The needle had been left along the river bank for three weeks.
The work was done along the old track, as it always was in those days.
The needle had been mended along the line of willows twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the needle along the whole morning again when nobody else would.
The whole shop never forgot what had been done along the river bank.
